'''Castle Panteer''' was the ancestral home of [[House Panteer]], located in the [[Glarus Valley]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. After the death of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Silara Panteer]] and her son [[Gaul Panteer]] around [[3653 BBY]], [[House Ulgo]]'s forces attacked the castle and set it ablaze, forcing House Panteer to retreat into a series of caves high in the mountains. The ruins of the castle were then occupied by the self-proclaimed king [[Bouris Ulgo]] and his forces.
